evidence.description: CodeSwarm SSE stream endpoint lacks authentication
evidence.impact: Anyone with a taskId can access task events without authentication

evidence.description: JWT token passed in WebSocket URL query parameter
evidence.code_snippet:
const wsUrl = `${wsProtocol}//${window.location.host}/ws/terminal?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}&cwd=${encodeURIComponent(cwd)}&sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`;
const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
evidence.impact: JWT token appears in URL query string, leaked via server logs, browser history, and Referer headers

evidence.description: JWT tokens stored in localStorage across all dashboard pages
evidence.code_snippet:
const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
const userStr = localStorage.getItem('user');
evidence.impact: Token accessible to any JavaScript on the same origin
No CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options headers set
